goal: Deprecate encrypting existing wallets to guide users toward creating encrypted wallets upfront
Prevent loss of funds from pre-encryption backups being invalidated when a new seed is generated
Avoid leaving plaintext keys on disk and silently altering descriptor spending conditions
reviewability: Author still needs to push an agreed test addition for reload persistence
agreement: Strong support for phasing out post-creation encryption as cleaner and safer (pablomartin4btc)
Suggested retaining test coverage for encryption persistence across reloads (Eunovo)
Approvals after minor feedback on docs and logging was resolved (achow101, w0xlt)
Concept approval without stated reasons (pseudoramdom, rkrux)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because encrypting an existing wallet is a dangerous trap that risks silent fund loss
Generating a new seed upon encryption renders pre-encryption backups useless
Deprecation protects users from altered descriptor spending rules and plaintext key residue on disk
